Wiring: List files.Files → Add path to annotations #3.Paths; List subfolders.Subfolders → Add path to annotations #3.Paths; Add path to annotations #3.Annotated paths → List files.Folders; Add path to annotations #3.Annotated paths → List subfolders.Folders.

chain-5-path-to-annotation-simple-import.description:
Sequence: Add path to annotations → ROI from file → Convert ROI to mask → Morphological operation 2D → Annotate with data.
Wiring: Morphological operation 2D.Output → Annotate with data.Annotation; Convert ROI to mask.Output → Morphological operation 2D.Input; ROI from file.Output → Convert ROI to mask.ROI; Add path to annotations.Annotated paths → ROI from file.Files.
chain-5-path-to-annotation-simple-import.name: Annotate with file/directory name -> Import ROI -> Convert 2D ROI to mask -> Morphological operation 2D -> Annotate with data
